summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned solely by maintain-knowledge-base with separate append-only maintainer-confirmed request; request binds caller, trigger, one existing target plan at pinned main, local main commit, timestamp, non-automatic status, knowledge-publication authority, and hash-verified stale-maintenance route; publish_knowledge_catalog.py --publish fails closed without bindings; stale-catalog route is typed, hash-bound, non-authorizing, append-only within target; VDD/Acceptance reject outputs outside exact target directory; semantic plan indexing excludes authority manifests and knowledge contexts to prevent recursive closure; standalone builder read-only, publication gate alone activates formal layers/pointers via validated capability; discovery supports versioned top-level requirements/contract/state/registry files and highest numeric version, including requirements-ledger and requirements names; historical generations remain readable, new publications record summary/hash; extends ADR-0044/0048/0050, supersedes none
